sensor_combine_modes.designated: Use one selected sensor for zone control.
sensor_combine_modes.highest: Use the hottest assigned sensor for zone control.
sensor_combine_modes.lowest: Use the coolest assigned sensor for zone control.
sensor_combine_modes.average: Use the average of all assigned sensors for zone control.

mapping_rules: A sensor may be assigned to more than one zone.
A zone may use one or more sensors.
A zone may command one or more relay outputs together.
A relay output may belong to only one zone to prevent conflicting commands.
All sensors selected by a group-combine mode must be valid; invalid members invalidate that zone measurement.
All outputs are disabled until a complete validated hardware configuration is explicitly applied.
sensor_control_rules: Sensor operating mode is configured per physical sensor, independently of zone assignment.
off disables acquisition, logging, PID use, and safety supervision for that sensor.
log_only acquires and logs readings and faults, does not affect PID, and remains part of kiln-wide safety.
log_control acquires and logs readings, may be selected for PID in one or more zones, and remains part of kiln-wide safety.
log_safety acquires and logs readings, remains part of kiln-wide safety, but is never used for PID.
Only sensors in log_control mode may be selected in a zone's control_sensor_channels.
Every enabled sensor is independently safety-supervised regardless of zone assignment or PID use.
Any enabled sensor reaching the configured maximum temperature trips the kiln; the highest sensor reading governs the combined safety decision.
A missing, stale, implausible, or electrically faulted enabled sensor trips kiln safety after the sensor-loss grace period.
Only off disables acquisition and safety supervision; every other mode is included in kiln-wide safety.

sensor_modes.off: No acquisition, logging, PID control, or safety supervision.
sensor_modes.log_only: Acquire and log readings and sensor faults; no PID control; included in kiln-wide safety.
sensor_modes.log_control: Acquire and log readings, allow PID use where assigned, and independently supervise kiln safety.
sensor_modes.log_safety: Acquire and log readings and independently supervise kiln safety; no PID control.
